title: 第10章
content_zh: 第1章 混乱KTV约好的地点在清风茶社的二楼，岚姐说已经到了，让易军快点来。当易军和唐青青出现在岚姐面前的时候，岚姐有点小小的意外。撞车那天她在现场见过唐青青，但没想到这个漂亮的小丫头这么快就和易军搅合在了一起。而易军也有点意外，因为在岚姐的身边，坐着一个很魁梧的汉子。而且以易军的眼光来看，这人一定是个不错的练家子。以前，易军从未听说过岚姐还有这样的朋友。“她叫唐青青，被高威那小子的手下给盯梢儿了。我怕她有什么闪失，就带了过来。”易军说着，又对唐青青说，“丫头你到旁边坐一会儿，随便点些东西，我和岚姐说点事情。”来的路上，易军就已经和唐青青约法三章，要求唐青青不能干扰他做自己的事。对此，唐青青并未表现出以往的刁蛮。她也知道自己毕竟只是跟着人家，总不能把人家的正事儿全都搅黄了。唐青青对着岚姐笑了笑，随即就跑开了，到了二楼围廊边的一张小桌子边坐下，出奇的老实。岚姐看了看唐青青的背影，笑了笑：“怎么，这就勾搭上了？”“哪有的事儿。”易军嘿嘿一乐，“其实，咱还是喜欢岚姐这样熟透了的味道。”反正都是开玩笑，无伤大雅，两人这样的玩笑也早就习惯了。但是，岚姐旁边的那个魁梧男人，却冷哼了一声，似乎瞧不惯易军的轻浮。在这样一个三人同处的环境里，这声冷哼很不和谐。岚姐笑了笑，说：“介绍一下。这位就是我说的易军，我的兄弟。军儿，这位兄弟叫董虎。年龄大你几岁，你喊‘虎哥’就行。”面对这个并不算友善的魁梧男人，易军并未以眼还眼以牙还牙，不然就掉了身价。而且，这位毕竟还是岚姐的朋友。“虎哥好，兄弟叫易军。”说着，易军伸出右手。但是，董虎却大大咧咧的坐着，一只手却端起了面前的茶盅，根本没有握手的意思。易军的手伸在半空，比较尴尬。但是这货也没计较，笑了笑坐在了岚姐的身边。对于这样一个尴尬气氛，岚姐也觉得有点别扭。但现在是商量事的时候，一些小事情要放在一边儿。原来，这董虎来自江宁市某家保镖公司，而且是这家公司的头号高手。只不过这种性质的公司一般是非正式的，所以对外的称呼也不挂“保镖”的字样儿，多是以“保安公司”冠名。地下世界是个生态多样化的环境，既有寻常的势力，也有保镖公司、讨债公司、私家侦探这样的偏门行业。而这家保镖公司的老板，也是岚姐的一个朋友。一开始，易军就觉得岚姐要是拉出来单干的话，太缺乏自己的势力。因为岚姐的能量，其实都是从七哥那样的大混子手中“借”来的。岚姐是个久经世事的主儿，既然易军想到了这一点，作为当事人的她更能看得透。所以，她竟然出了奇招儿，从保镖公司请了一批人手。她和保镖公司的老板关系不错，而且自己也不是不给钱，于是就请了董虎前来。这次，岚姐算是豁出去了。除了身手极好的董虎，同时还请了四个保镖。在岚姐的策划之中，这些都是她将来那家酒吧的保卫骨干。至于寻常看场子的混混马仔，以保安的名义再招揽一些，让董虎他们带着。总之有了董虎这样几个骨干，整个保安系统的大骨架就算是扎了起来。岚姐不是要跟别人去争什么，无非是让这些人看护一下自己的场子，应付一些寻常的小麻烦。所以，力量应该算是够用了。假如真有别的大混子来找麻烦，岚姐自信凭着以前的交情，还能周旋通融一下。在岚姐看来，这世间果然就没有用钱办不成的事儿。不过，聘请董虎等人的价格也确实不低。聘请他们五个，哪怕每天都没事儿做，岚姐每个月都要向保镖公司汇过去五万块。而且，董虎也不需要每天上班点卯，只需要那四个保镖蹲点儿就是了，假如真有棘手的事再请董虎出面——这也是岚姐和保镖公司老板达成的默契，那老板也极给岚姐面子。要不然，单是请董虎这个王牌保镖专职负责保卫，每月佣金就得五万这个数儿。岚姐的家底儿并不丰厚，每月五万不是个小数目。但岚姐也想了，自己最多聘请董虎他们半年时间，也就是花费大约三十万买个平安。半年之后，自己的酒吧也就积累了一批人手，基本成型了。到时候，让易军带着那群保安就是了。说到底，岚姐还是最信赖易军。但易军却觉得，这么做并不妥当。把自己的安全交到别人的手中，似乎并不是很靠谱儿。“租一栋小楼，年租金也就是二三十万。装修倒是要花费不小，但可以找一家经营不善的ktv盘下来，那么装修费用也就少了很多。”岚姐盘算着说，“男人到夜场里找乐呵，说到底还是看哪家的服务好、小姐档次高。这一点，咱们是有‘核心竞争力’的。”这么算下来，先期投资也就是一百万上下的样子。哪怕加上了董虎他们的佣金，预算也控制在150万以内。岚姐在夜场中摸爬滚打了多少年，咬咬牙还是能凑出这些现金的。而这样一个规模，在江宁市的ktv之中算是中等偏上。若是考虑到岚姐手头那些高档小姐资源，那么悬悬乎乎的挤进高档ktv圈子，也说得过去。毕竟江宁只是个二线城市，而ktv又不算大型的夜场。“你这是要背水一战了。”易军笑了笑。这些天和岚姐无话不谈，她知道岚姐除了房子、车子等固定资产，手头的现金也不是很多。甚至，为了凑齐150万，恐怕岚姐还得把一套投资用的小门市房给变卖了。岚姐笑了笑：“折腾了这么多年，也该想办法做点自己的事业了。成不成另说，总之姐要拼一把。对了，你觉得姐这个想法怎么样？”“还是那句话：我都听你的。”易军笑了笑。……今天白天的这次碰面，算是让易军认识认识董虎，因为以后可能要打交道半年时间。当然了，见面的气氛不是很融洽，因为董虎那个高高在上的心态，让易军根本不想过多的交往。当然，董虎也懒得跟易军废话。说到底，董虎瞧不起易军。在董虎看来，易军就是个贴在岚姐身边吃软饭的。而且，董虎心中还有自己别样的心思。半年前，当董虎乍一见到风姿妩媚入骨的岚姐之后，就产生了一种莫名的心痒。谈不上什么情和爱，纯粹是一种雄性牲口对雌性的本能反应。但是这种反应很强烈——事实上江宁地下世界中，把岚姐当做幻想对象的牲口们大有人在。他董虎不是第一个，也不会是最后一个。所以，看到岚姐如此信任易军，也让董虎自然产生了一股浓浓的醋味。由此带来的一个结果，就是董虎对易军产生了一种本能的排斥，甚至是敌视。如今算是认识了，董虎起身告辞。而走出了这家清风茶社，进入他那辆三菱帕杰罗之后，开车的一个光头小子当即转身笑问：“虎哥，谈得怎么样？”董虎哼哧了一声：“有什么好谈的，无非是见一见她未来的保安头子。说到底，就是让咱们带一带‘学徒工’。半年之后等他上路了，再把安保工作交给他。”那光头司机咧嘴，猥琐笑道：“谁问这个啦，咱是问您和秦岚大美女谈得咋样。嘿，虎哥你可别瞒兄弟们啦。上次你压在‘小白菜’身上折腾的时候，嘴里头喊的却是这个秦岚的名字呢，我在隔壁都听到了，嘿嘿。”“小王八蛋！”坐在副驾驶座的董虎笑着，一巴掌拍在了光头小子的后脑勺儿上，“开你的车！下午办点事儿，晚上……把小白菜接到我那里去。”估摸着，那个被称作“小白菜”的小姐，又要“客串”一回岚姐了。董虎找过不止一个女人“客串”岚姐，唯独小白菜能模仿出三分神韵。特别是小白菜在他雄壮的身子下娇呼“哥哥好猛、阿岚都快被哥哥弄死了”的时候，这畜生会产生一种莫名的血脉喷张。这个做法比较变态，但由此也能看出，这个一肚子闷骚的家伙，对岚姐的觊觎是何等的深沉而炽热。想到了岚姐那一身的媚骨，董虎小腹就忍不住一股火焰升腾。只不过，如今想到岚姐的时候，董虎会自觉不自觉的想到岚姐身边那个男人的身影。于是，yu火更盛，而妒火也更盛。董虎这个**的脸色，阴晴不定。
content_en: Chapter 1 Chaos KTV The appointed place is on the second floor of Qingfeng Tea House. Sister Lan said that she has arrived and asked Yi Jun to come quickly. When Yi Jun and Tang Qingqing appeared in front of Sister Lan, Sister Lan was a little surprised. She had seen Tang Qingqing at the scene on the day of the car crash, but she didn't expect that this beautiful little girl would get involved with Yi Jun so quickly. Yi Jun was also a little surprised, because sitting next to Sister Lan was a very burly man. And from Yi Jun's perspective, this man must be a good trainer. Before, Yi Jun had never heard that Sister Lan had such a friend. "Her name is Tang Qingqing, and she was being watched by the guys from Gaowei. I was afraid that something would happen to her, so I brought her here." Yi Jun said, and then said to Tang Qingqing, "Girl, please sit aside for a while and order something casually. Sister Lan and I will talk about something." On the way here, Yi Jun had already made a three-part agreement with Tang Qingqing, asking Tang Qingqing not to interfere with him doing his own thing. In this regard, Tang Qingqing did not show his previous unruliness. She also knew that she was just following someone after all, and she couldn't mess up all their business. Tang Qingqing smiled at Sister Lan, then ran away and sat down at a small table beside the corridor on the second floor, surprisingly honest. Sister Lan looked at Tang Qingqing's back and smiled: "Why, they're hooking up now?" "What's the big deal." Yi Jun chuckled, "Actually, we still like Sister Lan's familiar taste." Anyway, it's just a joke, it's harmless, and the two of them have long been used to such jokes. However, the burly man next to Sister Lan snorted coldly, as if he couldn't stand Yi Jun's frivolity. In such an environment where three people were together, this cold snort was very discordant. Sister Lan smiled and said, "Let me introduce you. This is the Yi Jun I'm talking about, my brother. Jun'er, this brother's name is Dong Hu. How many years older than you are, just call him 'Brother Tiger'." Facing this burly man who was not friendly, Yi Jun did not retaliate, otherwise he would lose his worth. Moreover, this person is still Sister Lan’s friend after all. "Hello Brother Hu, my brother's name is Yi Jun." After saying that, Yi Jun stretched out his right hand. However, Dong Hu sat carelessly, holding up the tea cup in front of him with one hand, without any intention of shaking hands. Yi Jun's hand was stretched out in the air, which was quite embarrassing. But this guy didn't care, he smiled and sat next to Sister Lan. Sister Lan also felt a little awkward about such an awkward atmosphere. But now is the time to discuss things, and some small things need to be put aside. It turned out that Dong Hu came from a certain bodyguard company in Jiangning City, and was the number one expert in this company. However, companies of this nature are generally informal, so they are not called "bodyguard" when called to the outside world, but are often named "security company". The underground world is an ecologically diverse environment, with both ordinary forces and side industries such as bodyguard companies, debt collection agencies, and private detectives. The owner of this bodyguard company is also a friend of Sister Lan. From the beginning, Yi Jun felt that Sister Lan would lack her own power if she was pulled out to work alone. Because Sister Lan's energy was actually "borrowed" from bastards like Brother Qi. Sister Lan is a experienced woman. Now that Yi Jun has thought of this, as the person involved, she can see through it more clearly. Therefore, she unexpectedly came up with a strange idea and hired a group of people from the bodyguard company. She had a good relationship with the owner of the bodyguard company, and she didn't want to pay him, so she invited Dong Hu to come. This time, Sister Lan finally took the risk. In addition to the extremely skilled Dong Hu, he also hired four bodyguards. In Sister Lan's plan, these are the backbone of her future bar guards. As for the gangsters who usually watch the show, they recruit some more in the name of security and let Dong Hu and others take them with them. In short, with a few backbones like Dong Hu, the skeleton of the entire security system has been established. Sister Lan doesn't want to argue with others, she just wants these people to look after her place and deal with some ordinary little troubles. Therefore, the power should be considered sufficient. If there is another gangster who comes to cause trouble, Sister Lan is confident that she can deal with it a little bit based on her previous friendship. From Sister Lan's point of view, there is really nothing in this world that cannot be done with money. However, the price of hiring Dong Hu and others is indeed not low. Hiring five of them, even if there is nothing to do every day, Sister Lan will have to remit 50,000 yuan to the bodyguard company every month. Moreover, Dong Hu does not need to go to work every day, he only needs the four bodyguards to stay at home. If there is really a difficult matter, Dong Hu will be asked to come forward - this is also the tacit agreement reached between Sister Lan and the boss of the bodyguard company, and the boss will give Sister Lan a lot of face. Otherwise, just hiring Dong Hu, an ace bodyguard, to be responsible for full-time security would cost fifty thousand in monthly commissions. Sister Lan's family is not rich, and 50,000 yuan per month is not a small amount. But Sister Lan also thought about it. She would hire Dong Hu and the others for half a year at most, which would cost about 300,000 yuan to buy Ping An. Half a year later, my bar has accumulated a number of people and is basically taking shape. When the time comes, just let Yi Jun lead the group of security guards. After all, Sister Lan still trusts Yi Jun the most. But Yi Jun felt that this was not appropriate. It doesn't seem very reliable to put your own safety in the hands of others. "The annual rent for renting a small building is 20,000 to 300,000 yuan. Decoration will cost a lot, but if you can find a KTV that is not well managed, then the decoration cost will be much less." Sister Lan calculated and said, "When men go to nightclubs to find entertainment, they still have to look at which one has good service and high-quality girls. In this regard, we have 'core competitiveness.'" Calculated in this way, the upfront investment is about one million.
